Rishi / Marissa — quick update and a blocker.

- Action A (SLA delta): The fallback model (quantized variant) meets token-cold p95 ~140ms on our standard kernel stack; with the optimized kernels (vendor-provided) we approach 115-120ms. The optimized kernels are NOT in the current Dedicated image.
- Blocker: vendor build for optimized kernels is in testing and not yet signed off. If we push for vendor kernels, lead time is ~2 business days plus validation window.

Options:
1) Approve vendor kernel build now -> projected SLA meet (120ms) but requires coordination with Ops (Marissa) for rollout and an extra validation day.
2) Accept quantified fallback variant for the QBR (callout to exec that p95 will be ~140ms) and pursue kernel rollout post-readout.

I recommend Option 1 if exec appetite for SLA is strong; Option 2 if we prefer to avoid risk to Dedicated image stability. Please indicate preferred approach — I can scope the vendor validation and attach an implementation checklist.
